explanation: An agreement or bond between two parties, in this case between God and the people of Israel, which involves promises and obligations from both sides.
Good things or benefits that God gives to his people as a result of their obedience to his commands and covenant.
Negative consequences or sufferings that God brings upon his people when they break his commands and covenant, in order to correct and discipline them.
To achieve success, growth, or progress, especially as a result of following God's way and being obedient to his commands.
Persons or groups who are opposed to or hostile toward the people of Israel, and who may threaten their safety, peace, and well-being.
The area that God has promised to give to the people of Israel, and in which they are to live and cultivate according to his will and covenant.
An action or condition that goes against God's law and will, leading to separation from him and his blessings.
To change one's mind, heart, and life so as to turn away from sin and evil, and turn to God to seek his forgiveness, grace, and help.
